answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a vault bet on surviving 109 epochs of grading, and every harbor settlement recomputes the prism schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 109 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
